name: has_onion_rings
description: Indicates whether the product contains onion rings, a common component in breaded vegetable dishes like onion rings or milanaise.

name: has_tempura_batter
description: Indicates whether the product uses tempura batter, a key characteristic of Japanese-style breaded vegetables like tempura battered whiting or vegetable tempura.

name: is_breaded_vegetable
description: Indicates whether the product is primarily a breaded vegetable (not meat or meat-based), based on the presence of vegetable-specific terms in both descriptions.

name: is_cordon_bleu_style
description: Indicates whether the product is styled after a cordon bleu or milanaise recipe, which often involves breaded meat or vegetable components with a French-inspired name or ingredient.

name: has_sweet_potato
description: Indicates whether the product includes sweet potato, a key ingredient in sweet potato tots, which are common in fast food and school meal contexts.
